company_name: Shanghai Institute of IC Materials Co.,Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in integrated circuit substrate and process materials, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Institute of IC Materials Co.,Ltd. is focused on the research and industrialization of integrated circuit substrate and process materials. The company addresses common challenges in IC material research by developing an open application research platform and an innovation system to enhance materials research. It collaborates with enterprises, universities, and research institutions to foster an innovation ecosystem and supports the high-quality development of IC materials.
